## Setup

```{r setup}
root <- system("git rev-parse --show-toplevel", intern = TRUE)
out  <- Sys.getenv("OUT", file.path(root, "tmp/experiments/<task>"))
need <- file.path(out, "<main object>.rds")
if (!file.exists(need)) stop("Missing ", need, ": run `experiment/run.sh <stage>` first.")
# source("experiment/<helpers>.R")   # reuse the experiment's own code
obj <- readRDS(need)
```
